title: Present and exit while retaining the active slide
preconditions: Select second slide B of a two-slide implementation deck; Item hotspots and documentation chrome are visible initially.

steps.expected_result: B fills the presentation surface without documentation chrome or Item hotspots.

steps.action: Exit presentation with its control or Escape.
steps.expected_result: The normal reader returns with B still active and its original slide position.

expected_result: The normal reader returns with B still active and its original slide position.
